after.RouteNotes: CB: route replaced (traced from published map) — The open season map draws the existing Crossroads mainline from Cygnet, Ohio to Schererville, Indiana. This trace was first applied to P8315, the proposed expansion, on 2026-10-23. It shows the existing line, not new pipe, so Baird moved it here on 2026-11-05. The map is a schematic, and its station dots sit 4 to 11 km from the real towns, so accuracy is low. The trace is 326 km, about 203 miles, close to the 202 miles on this row.
